summary: Tested the fix for SuppliersPage.js crash (removed dead 'Assignment Add/Edit Dialog' code) and the new future-bill-date warning flag in the ERP Prices panel. Focused heavily on the Quota Arrangement UI flow (main new feature) plus regression checks on Purchasing Plan, Supplier CRUD, SapWritePage, and Inventory Entity filter. All scenarios passed.

design_issues.screen: Suppliers - Quota Arrangement panel, '+ Add Supplier' picker
issues: The 'Pick a supplier...' dropdown lists all ~2984 suppliers alphabetically with no search/filter/typeahead-jump support, only mouse-wheel scroll. Finding a specific supplier (e.g. one starting with 'S') requires many scroll actions. Not a functional bug (selection does work once scrolled to and clicked), but a UX friction point worth adding a search input to the Select for usability at this data scale.

critical_code_review_comments: Confirmed via grep that the dead 'Assignment Add/Edit Dialog' code block and unused SelectGroup/SelectLabel/SelectSeparator imports are fully removed from SuppliersPage.js - no leftover references to assignmentDialogOpen/assignmentForm/saveAssignment found.

isFutureBillDate() helper + WarningCircle icon rendering verified present at multiple usage sites (ERP panel 'Most Recent'/'Lowest Seen' columns, plus 2 other panel warning usages) - code renders fine for normal past-dated rows (tested on 100534-405, 100534-464, SCR415WM); did not encounter a live 2027+ bill_date row in this session's spot-checks, but no rendering breakage was observed for any row.
Frontend compiles cleanly (webpack 'Compiled successfully'), backend logs show no 500s or unhandled exceptions during this test session.
test_credentials: SAP Write page passcode: 'admin' (confirmed working, no regression)
seed_data_creation: Created a 2nd test revision on SCR415WM's quota arrangement (remarks prefixed 'TEST_', set-by 'TEST_QA_Agent') to verify Confirm + Revision History flow - this is real persisted data (revision 2) but is clearly marked with TEST_ prefix and matches the same 55/30/15 split as revision 1, so no functional data was corrupted. Also made a temporary Contact Person edit on supplier '165 DEGREE' during CRUD regression test, then reverted it back to empty ('--') before finishing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full pass this session, no bugs found in the actual application code. Verified end-to-end: (1) Suppliers page loads without crash for 100534-405, 100534-464, SCR415WM, and via 'SCR' autosuggest (dropdown shows Product ID + description correctly). (2) Quota Arrangement panel: quota%/lead-time edits live-update the Total indicator (turns red text '(must equal 100%)' when != 100%, plain black '100.0%' when =100%), Confirm button correctly disables/enables based on total. (3) Remove row (X icon) recalculates total correctly. (4) '+ Add Supplier' -> 'Pick a supplier' Select -> pick option -> 'Add' button correctly adds a new row with quota 0 and rationale 'Manually added by buyer', keeping total consistent - this DOES work correctly, my first few attempts failed only because my Playwright locator (text match) was ambiguously matching the identically-named row in the Supplier Master List table above instead of the dropdown's role=option element; using get_by_role('option') resolved this test-script issue immediately - NOT an app bug. (5) Confirming a 2nd revision with Remarks + Set By worked, showed toast 'Quota arrangement saved', updated the revision label to 'SCR415WM-1 · revision 2', and 'Show Revision History' expanded a table with Rev#/Date/Source=Buyer/By/Remarks/Allocations for both revisions. (6) Multi-supplier AI-weighted split was pre-existing/verified on SCR415WM (55/30/15 with rationale text per supplier: 'lowest price', 'second lowest, buyer bumped up...', 'backup') - confirms the LLM suggestion logic produces sensible weighted splits with human-readable rationale. (7) REGRESSION all passed: Purchasing Plan page generated successfully (took ~150s, expected per known SAP tenant slowness) and product 100534-405 row shows 'HAMIDI EXPORTS 100%' badge (not 'No supplier assigned') confirming the quota-arrangement -> part_suppliers projection -> Purchasing Plan read integration works end-to-end. Supplier Edit dialog (data-testid=supplier-dialog) opens/saves/persists correctly. SapWritePage passcode gate ('admin') + bulk push UI unaffected. Inventory Entity filter (All Entities -> RAY INTERNATIONAL) correctly filters 3180 -> 872 items. Did not find a live product with a future (2027+) bill_date in ERP data during spot checks of 100534-405/464/SCR415WM, so the future-date warning icon rendering itself could not be visually confirmed with real bad data this session, but confirmed the code path doesn't break normal rows - this matches the task's own caveat that it's fine if no bad-data row is found.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no bugs found in the app this session. The only 'failures' encountered during testing were test-script locator ambiguity (Playwright text-matching a supplier name that appeared both in the Supplier Master List table and inside a Select dropdown's option list) - resolved by switching to get_by_role('option') scoped locators; not an application defect.
